name: SG1050 (Double Sided Rotation)
tagline: Grand double-sided viewing panel on an innovative rotating pedestal base
description: The SG1050 (Double Sided Rotation) is a luxurious, large-format tunnel wood stove designed to sit gracefully as a focal centerpiece in upscale, open-plan spaces. Featuring matching front and rear panoramic glass windows, it treats viewers to an expansive, dual-aspect exhibition of the fire. The entire firebox is mounted on a heavy-duty, circular rotating pedestal stem, allowing users to effortlessly reorient the unit to face different seating arrangements or adjoining rooms with absolute ease.
features: Innovative rotating pedestal mechanism allowing full direction adjustments of the fireplace
Double-sided panoramic format providing a breathtaking tunnel view of the flames from both sides
Extra-wide front and back ceramic glass doors for an uncompromised distribution of radiant heat
Sleek architectural black frame trim that aligns beautifully with ultra-modern home layouts
Substantial 200mm diameter top flue pipe configuration engineered for maximum drafting efficiency
